summary: Eupraxia Pharmaceuticals filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing participation in the Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference on June 3, 2026. The filing is a routine report of a corporate event with no financial terms, deal structure, board recommendation, or transaction mechanics. It does not constitute an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. This is a standard current report of a conference participation event for a foreign private issuer.
